entrypoints.summary: One task reaches execveat through bprm_execve while another reaches clone3 and copy_fs.
The affected guard state is intended to deny clone(CLONE_FS) from another sub-thread during an exec transition.

affected_components.role: Sets and clears fs_struct->in_exec across exec success and failure transitions.
Reads the shared state on the concurrent clone3 path identified by KCSAN.

code_slices.fixed: The patch clears current->fs->in_exec after de_thread succeeds or in free_bprm before cred_guard_mutex is unlocked.
code_slices.surrounding_context: check_unsafe_exec sets the flag to deny clone(CLONE_FS) from another sub-thread until de_thread succeeds and documents cred_guard_mutex as its protection.
code_slices.vulnerable: The old bprm_execve exit paths clear current->fs->in_exec locklessly after an exec outcome.

observability.positive_marker: Report identifies a bprm_execve write racing with a copy_fs read and records a one-to-zero value change.

sources.concept: failed exec transition after setting the shared in-exec guard

impact.affected_asset: Integrity of shared fs_struct->in_exec lifecycle state and the exec/CLONE_FS exclusion invariant.
impact.attacker_capability: A local process able to coordinate threads invoking execveat and clone3 may attempt the documented failed-exec interleaving; practical reliability and any escalation consequence are not established.
impact.security_effect: Violation of the guard that excludes concurrent clone(CLONE_FS) during the relevant exec transition, observed as a KCSAN data race.

causal_trace.summary: A multithreaded process concurrently enters an execve path and a clone3 path that reads the shared fs_struct state.
After T1 sets fs->in_exec and its exec fails, T1 drops cred_guard_mutex; T2 sets the flag for its own execution window; T1 then performs its old lockless clear, leaving T2 with in_exec equal to zero.
The diagnostic records a conflicting four-byte write in bprm_execve and read in copy_fs, with the observed value changing from one to zero.
The exec/CLONE_FS exclusion guard can be cleared during T2's protected execution window; the directly observed outcome is a KCSAN data-race report.

failure.operation: Lockless clear of current->fs->in_exec on an exec exit path races with copy_fs and can overwrite a later execution window's guard state.

primary_invariant.statement: fs_struct->in_exec must remain set to deny clone(CLONE_FS) from another sub-thread until de_thread() succeeds, and this state is protected by cred_guard_mutex.
primary_invariant.violated_because: An exec error path cleared the shared flag after releasing cred_guard_mutex, allowing an earlier failing thread to erase the guard established by a later thread.

quality.review_notes: Primary report records one KCSAN observation and explicitly states that no reproducer was available. The merged patch provides a concrete interleaving and corrective state ownership, but the bundle contains no post-fix run, deterministic testcase, or demonstrated consequence beyond loss of the exclusion guard and sanitizer-detected race.

remediation.invariant_restored: Clear fs_struct->in_exec only while cred_guard_mutex remains held: after successful de_thread() in begin_new_exec or in free_bprm before unlocking on failure.

state_context.attacker_state_setup: Two tasks share fs_struct state; one exec transition must fail before de_thread succeeds, while another reaches its in-exec window after the first releases cred_guard_mutex.
data_structure_invariants: fs_struct->in_exec is the exclusion state for clone(CLONE_FS) during the specified exec interval.
cred_guard_mutex protects this state across the transition and its cleanup.
state_context.state_machine: T1 sets in_exec under cred_guard_mutex; T1 fails and unlocks; T2 sets in_exec; T1's old cleanup clears it; T2 continues with the guard cleared.

target.component: exec/fs_struct in_exec lifecycle and CLONE_FS exclusion

oracle.expected_negative: No post-fix targeted execution result is supplied; a lack of the reported conflicting access under an equivalent KCSAN workload would be the relevant negative observation.
oracle.expected_positive: On the reported affected kernel and scheduling interleaving, KCSAN reports the conflicting bprm_execve write and copy_fs read of the shared state.
